name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a silver-gold development company advancing its 100%-owned Diablillos project in the Puna region of Salta and Catamarca provinces, Argentina. The project is fully permitted and DFS-complete with an after-tax NPV5% of US$3.0B and 41.9% IRR, targeting first production in 2029 with average annual output of 14 Moz silver and 89 koz gold in the first five years.
